description: SPD & SPT GIS Shapefiles - Point Assets is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. To access the GIS Shapefiles section of our Open Data Portal please submit a request using the following form. This section of the Portal is subject to our Shared Data Licence Terms and Conditions within the attached link. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are GIS, Shapefiles, Local Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
